custody_telemetry.source: operator custody telemetry; not an independent provider audit

method.bootstrap: Resample template clusters with replacement within each row; retain all member items. Reuse the same draws for every prompt/layer/position/arm in that row; row seed = seed + registered row index.
method.control_quantile: Per row/prompt/layer/position, empirical 95th percentile of same-value donor-signed per-item (patched - recipient) changes, NumPy linear interpolation; complete items required. Descriptive, not a hypothesis-test threshold or a bootstrap percentile of means.
method.layer_convention: Decoder block input residuals; layer 0 is the native injected embedding before block 0.
method.orientation: Raw scores remain A-minus-B. Donor-signed changes multiply by +1 for donor label A and -1 for B, never by the observed score sign.
method.raw_baselines: Recipient, full-donor and patched scores plus numerator/denominator are retained in paired records and immutable scores.
method.undefined_policy: An exactly zero denominator is undefined. Any missing/undefined item makes the main cell fraction mean and CI NOT_EVALUABLE; no dropping, imputation, epsilon or clipping. Finite near-zero ratios remain included.

prediction.reason: No numerical early/mid/late boundary or decision percentile sampling axis is invented. Complete layer curves and an explicitly defined descriptive control percentile are reported.

registered_half_recovery_evidence.interpretation: Observed threshold crossings only; no early/mid/late boundary or uncertainty decision threshold added.
